primary.report_quote: Revenue and operating income are the corresponding reported financial measures; operating margin equals operating income divided by revenue. OCF means operating cash flow. Capex means capital expenditures, represented in the corpus by purchases of property and equipment. Free cash flow (FCF) is cash remaining after capex: **FCF = OCF − capex**. Capex intensity measures the share of operating cash flow absorbed by investment: **capex intensity = capex / OCF**. Amounts are in US$ billions unless expressed as percentages. [S1] [S6]

## Cross-Company Comparison

Amazon has the largest revenue base among the six companies, followed by Apple and Alphabet, while NVIDIA has the smallest. Conversely, NVIDIA records the highest operating margin and Amazon the lowest; Apple and Alphabet are tied between these extremes [S2][S5].
